During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an '''agricultural freighter''' in the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]] embarked on an expedition to find [[Roonstone]]s. After the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]], [[Oggem Baobab]] was stranded there and lived in the freighter for the next sixty years until he was found by his great nephew, [[Mungo Baobab]],<ref name="AtRS">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref> in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="Polyhedron170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref>
